newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA COACH BRUCE YARDLEY TO MISS ASIA CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA COACH BRUCE YARDLEY TO MISS ASIA CUP.

text.p: World Cup champions Sri Lanka will be without their coach, former Australian test player Bruce Yardley, when they open their campaign in the four-nation Asia Cup on Monday, cricket officials said on Saturday.
The Board of Control for Cricket in Sri Lanka said in a statement that Yardley would leave for Australia on Tuesday for an overdue medical checkup.
Cricket officials said Yardley had problems with his left eye and has been asked by his doctors to come to Australia for treatment.
The four-nation Asia Cup begins on Monday when hosts Sri Lanka take on Pakistan in the first match in Colombo. India and Bangladesh are the other two teams playing in the tournament.
Cricket officials said Yardley was expected to be back on the island in time for Sri Lanka's two-test match series against India, which starts after the Asia Cup tournament is over on July 26.
